*ORB Strategy with Breakout, Pullback & Continuation Pattern | 5-Year Backtest Results (S&P 500)*

I’ve been trading the Opening Range Breakout (ORB) strategy for the last 6 months and found it consistently profitable. But one variation I see everywhere online is the breakout + pullback continuation pattern. On paper, it looks like a strong setup — but does it actually hold up in a backtest?

In this video, I test that exact idea on 5 years of S&P 500 data. I’ll explain the strategy rules, show you how I coded it into my backtester, and walk through the full results.

If you’ve ever wondered whether waiting for the pullback improves ORB performance, this video will give you the answer.

*What’s in this video?*
- Quick recap of the basic ORB rules
- How the breakout + pullback continuation logic works
- Full 5-year backtest on SPX data
- Trade examples and equity curve results

*Tools Used for Backtesting*

- Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib
